S1_refusal_without_batch_removed._note: --prune-oracle without --batch runs a single query silently as if the flag were absent (O11).

S2_oracle_flag_not_dispatched._note: --batch … --prune-oracle prints answers instead of verdicts (O17). The axes that drive the flag through the command see it too: no oracle summary comes back, so neither `--timeout` (O33) nor `--use-cache` (O34) can be judged.
